decision: Treat Phase 1 as the five-unit pilot
why: The package and domain contracts constrain every later phase

decision: Isolate rewrite work under target package paths
why: The current main worktree contains unrelated alpha edits that must survive

decision: Use the plain orchestration store format
why: The Poteto orchestration helper is not installed and adding it is not a Crit product requirement

decision: Choose private npm workspaces with TypeScript project references
why: Physical package boundaries enforce the target ownership graph and let platform libraries vary without relying only on a custom checker

decision: Keep nine future packages empty during the scaffold
why: Ownership fences are useful now but speculative interfaces would create shallow modules

decision: Use fixtures to port alpha behavior
why: The rewrite needs stable invariants without importing alpha types or implementation
The negative gauntlet found alpha import, graph drift, root completeness, and real workspace resolution false passes

decision: Require five artifacts to agree for every package edge
why: A declared edge was not buildable until manifest, reference, resolver, checker, and compiled import matched

decision: Separate authenticated Principal from durable accepted attribution
why: Authentication subjects authorize requests but do not belong in Canvas history

decision: Nest runtime details under client-reported provenance
why: Harness and model details are useful but not verified by the Crit authority

decision: Reject ambiguous route and host encodings
why: Durable Representation identity must not depend on browser normalization or alternate loopback spelling

decision: Reserve percent encoding for canonical non-ASCII UTF-8
why: Allowing escaped ASCII created multiple durable names for the same application route

decision: Limit web-url to canonical public DNS hosts
why: Runtime-neutral handling of IP and intranet aliases could not guarantee one host identity

decision: Keep semantic Change values public and versioned wire roots private
why: Authority and Replica should not carry transport version fields

decision: Start with one preconditioned RenameCanvas command
why: The protocol needs real unauthored intent but CanvasEngine must own the larger mutation vocabulary

decision: Return the full accepted Change in retry receipts
why: A Replica can settle pending work without an immediate pull

decision: Model Cursor as a validated branded token without interpretation helpers
why: The protocol needs JSON-safe pass-through opacity; native string behavior is not a security boundary
